lines.en: Every step shakes the ground below.
I do not look at the path, I listen to it.

lines.zh: 脚掌落在幽匿上，没有声音
lines.en: My feet fall on sculk without a sound.
Stone crumbles beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里走，不需要灯
lines.en: I walk in darkness and need no lamp.
This corridor leads further down.

lines.zh: 我的脚步让尘埃落下来
lines.en: My steps bring the dust down.
Walk slowly, search slowly.
The air underground moves with me.

lines.zh: 我把整片深暗走了一遍
lines.en: I have walked the whole deep dark.
The silence here belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我等一个会发出声音的东西
lines.en: I wait for something that makes noise.
The sculk breathes, and I hear it.
Nobody has come down here for a long time.
When I stand still, the deep goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我的胸口在发光，也发热
lines.en: My chest glows, and it gives off heat.
The living things above are noisy.

lines.zh: 我数过这层的每一条裂缝
lines.en: I have counted every crack on this level.

lines.zh: 石头记得我走过多少次
lines.en: The stone remembers how often I passed.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有脚步
lines.en: I hear footsteps very far away.
There should be nothing here at all.
A layer of dust hangs on my horns.
I do not sleep, and I do not need to.

lines.zh: 深处还有没被封住的门
lines.en: Deeper still, a door remains unsealed.

lines.zh: 幽匿块在脚下轻轻地吸。
lines.en: The sculk blocks breathe softly under my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬头，上面有一层很远的响。
lines.en: I raise my head; far above there is a layer of noise.
You are small, standing in the light.
I see your shape now.
Holding your breath is too late.
Your heartbeat is loud down here.
You look up at me, good.

lines.zh: 我低下头，是为了看清你
lines.en: I lower my head to see you clearly.
You carry the smell of the outside.
Do not blink, I will remember it.

lines.zh: 你已经站在我的地上了
lines.en: You are already standing on my ground.
Your shadow lies beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我看不见，但我知道你在
lines.en: I cannot see, but I know you are there.

lines.zh: 你带着火把，我不喜欢火
lines.en: You bring a torch, I dislike fire.
You hit me, and I remember.
That felt like a mosquito.
A crack has opened in my hide.
You actually dared come close.
I do not retreat, I never retreat.

lines.zh: 声音从我的伤口传出去
lines.en: Sound leaks out of my wound.
This scratch cannot wake my anger.
Did you hear my low growl?
I did not take a single step back.
You will regret that strike.
I will not eat what you hold.

lines.zh: 你举着的，对我毫无意义
lines.en: What you raise means nothing to me.
Gold does not shine down here.
Take it away, I want only quiet.
What would you trade that for?

lines.zh: 我不需要食物，也不需要你
lines.en: I need no food, and I need no you.
That thing rattles annoyingly.
Put it away, do not wave it in the deep.

lines.zh: 我什么都不缺，除了安静
lines.en: I lack nothing here except silence.

lines.zh: 你给的，我一口都不会碰
lines.en: I will not touch a bite of your offering.
You hit the wall, not me.
My body is heavier than stone.
Step away, I do not wish to touch you.
That was only a warning.
You are far too close.
My hide feels nothing.
You were thrown back, good.
Do not approach me from behind.
I stopped to give you a chance.

lines.zh: 再碰一次，我就不客气了
lines.en: Touch me again and I stop being gentle.
There is only one of me underground.
I have no need for another.
The shriek only wakes me.
The deep has room for no second one.
This is not a thing I should consider.
I do not breed, I only keep watch.
My kind never walk together.
What you ask belongs to living things.
Solitude is the rule down here.
I leave no offspring, only sculk.
Something lies there, I step over it.
I pick nothing up and leave nothing.
Did you drop that bone?
It cracked apart under my foot.
I do not collect things.
Keep your belongings close, do not drop them.
Everything in the deep belongs to sculk.

lines.zh: 我拾起的声音会传很远
lines.en: The sound of me lifting it travels far.
I have no use for trophies.
Move aside, I am walking through.
A sound. On the left.

lines.zh: 我听见你踩碎了一块石头
lines.en: I heard you crack a stone.
A scent comes down from above.
You moved, so now I know.
Vibration, very close, on this level.
Another one who took the wrong path.
The shrieker woke me.
A heartbeat, once, twice.
You are running, running toward me.
The smell here has changed.
The steps stopped, but you remain.
I have locked onto that patch of dark.
You cannot hide, your scent spreads.
This time I do not need to wait.
Do not move, let me come closer.
The quieter you are, the harder I search.
You backed into the corner, good.
My heartbeat is quickening.
Listen, the sound wave is coming.
I open my mouth for you.

lines.zh: 你会被自己的心跳出卖
lines.en: Your own heartbeat will betray you.
There is no exit here for you.
I press forward one step at a time.
Raise your shield, it cannot stop sound.
Your scent grows nearer.
The rock wall is behind you.
Breathe slower, I can hear it.
You are already inside my reach.

lines.zh: 你把火把熄了，可我还记得。
lines.en: You put out the torch, but I still remember.

lines.zh: 你脚下的幽匿在替你说话。
lines.en: The sculk under your feet speaks for you.
This blow makes the ground tremble.
Block it and your arm will break.
My fist is heavier than your shield.
The sound arrives first, the force after.
You flew away, good.
I raise my hand, your armor splits.
This one will not need a second.
You lie on the ground, still alive.

lines.zh: 我的骨节碾过你的盔甲
lines.en: My knuckles grind across your armor.
You stepped far back and still got hit.

lines.zh: 我打了个空，墙替你挨了
lines.en: I missed, and the wall took it.
I held back, you should thank me.
I heard the sound of bone.

lines.zh: 别站起来，我不想再动手
lines.en: Stay down, I do not want to swing again.
The shrieking is enough, I am here.
I was woken from beneath the earth.
The warning reached the fourth.
The deep dark tears open.

lines.zh: 我在这片幽匿上站起来
lines.en: I rise upon this field of sculk.
Who has been striking those shriekers?
I am here, the deep should fall silent.
My shadow falls first.
The world above is far too loud.
I have waited here for many years.

lines.zh: 震动把我从沉睡里拉起
lines.en: Vibration pulled me up from sleep.
This level of stone is mine to keep.
You should not have dug this far.
I am standing, do not move.
The fourth warning. That is enough.

lines.zh: 尖啸体的口子自己撕开了。
lines.en: The shrieker's mouth tears itself open.
I am pushed up through the stone seams.
Every crack on this level is moving.
Wherever the knocking is, that is where I go.

lines.zh: 深暗的顶太低，我弯了一下腰。
lines.en: The deep dark ceiling is low; I stoop once.
Fire is glaring in the deep.
Even stone cannot catch my fall.
Water, I am not familiar with it.
You are using explosives to disturb me.
Arrows from afar, far too light.
That light is not like mine.
I eat nothing, and I never starve.
The thunder above reached down here.
There is somewhere deeper still below.
